Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the mention of the cemetery, add an observed detail such as “他常常看见人们来墓地祭拜” to make the setting more concrete.
2. At the point where he goes there with friends, add his feeling, such as “孟子觉得祭拜很有趣”, to show why he is interested in the place.

ideas.reason: This concrete observation fits the cemetery setting and helps explain what Mengzi sees there.
This feeling fits the tale because young Mengzi becomes interested in and imitates cemetery rituals.
